Description: As an applicant, I want to enter my personal details, so that I can open a savings account digitally without visiting a branch. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I have started an application, when I reach the details step, then I can enter my full name, date of birth, mobile number, email and residential address.. Notes: In scope: individual savings accounts on mobile and web (C s2). [not stated] field validation, mandatory vs optional fields, address format.

As the bank, I want only customers aged 18 or over to open an account, so that the minimum-age rule is met. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given an applicant is 18 or over, when they apply, then they are eligible to proceed.; AC2: Given an applicant is under 18, when they apply, then they cannot open the account.. Notes: (assumed) age is determined from the date of birth collected in FR-1. [not stated] when the check happens and what the applicant sees.

As an applicant, I want to verify my mobile number with a one-time passcode (OTP), so that the bank can confirm the number is mine. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I have entered my mobile number, when I enter the correct OTP within 5 minutes of it being issued, then my number is verified.; AC2: Given an OTP was issued more than 5 minutes ago, when I enter it, then it is not accepted.; AC3: Given I have made 3 incorrect attempts, when I try again, then no further attempt is allowed.. Notes: [not stated] what happens after the attempt limit (lockout, new OTP, resend), delivery channel, passcode length.

Summary: Upload photo ID and take selfie for Veridian check
Description: As an applicant, I want to upload a photo ID and take a selfie, so that my identity can be verified without a branch visit. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I am at the ID verification step, when I upload a photo ID and take a selfie, then both are sent to Veridian for verification.; AC2: Given Veridian has assessed my ID and selfie, when it responds, then the result is pass, fail or refer.. Notes: Dependency: Veridian contract signed and sandbox live (A [00:52]); integration owner Ananya Rao (C s5). [not stated] what happens on fail or refer (G-2); FR-4 is blank (G-1).

As an applicant, I want live feedback while I take my selfie, so that I can fix problems during capture instead of failing at the end. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I am capturing my selfie, when the capture is not suitable (the only example given is being too far away), then I see live guidance such as 'move closer' during capture, not only a failure at the end.. Notes: Only 'move closer' is given as an example; other conditions [not stated]. [not stated] whether guidance comes from Veridian or is built in-house. Priya's reply at [01:20] does not clearly confirm this item (G-6).

Summary: Accept T&Cs and privacy notice before submitting
Description: As a Compliance officer, I want applicants to accept the T&Cs and privacy notice before they can submit, so that acceptance is obtained before an application goes through. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given an applicant has not accepted both the T&Cs and the privacy notice, when they try to submit, then submission is not possible.; AC2: Given an applicant has accepted both, when they submit, then submission is allowed.. Notes: [not stated] whether acceptance is recorded or versioned, where it sits in the flow, what counts as 'submit'.

Summary: Straight-through processing with no manual review
Description: As an applicant, I want my application processed end to end without manual review, so that I can open an account digitally without delay. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given my ID check is completed via Veridian, when the result is available, then my application is processed straight through with no manual review by operations.. Notes: Conflicts with S-08 (see C-1). Handling of fail and refer results [not stated] (G-2).

Summary: Manual Compliance review for non-domestic residential address
Description: As a Compliance officer, I want applicants whose residential address is outside the country routed to manual review, so that the regulator requirement is met. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given an applicant's residential address is outside the country, when their application reaches activation, then it is routed to manual Compliance review.; AC2: Given an applicant's residential address is outside the country, when manual Compliance review has not been completed, then the account is not activated (no exceptions).. Notes: Conflicts with S-07 and S-14 (see C-1). Marcus: regulator requirement, 'not optional'. Priya's view that it is a small edge case is not backed by any figure in the sources. [not stated] reviewer assignment, review outcomes, time limit, what the applicant is told while waiting, which country, how residence is determined (G-4).

As an applicant, I want an account number issued when my application is approved, so that I have an account to use. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given my application has been approved, when approval occurs, then an account number is issued.. Notes: 'Approval' is not defined: who or what approves, and whether it includes Compliance review (G-5, C-1).

As an applicant, I want an SMS when my account is opened, so that I know it is ready. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given my account has been opened, when opening completes, then an SMS is sent to me.. Notes: (assumed) sent to the mobile number from FR-1. [not stated] message content and timing; exact meaning of 'opened' (G-5).

As an applicant, I want an email with my welcome pack, so that I have my account information in writing. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given my account has been opened, when opening completes, then an email containing the welcome pack PDF is sent to me.. Notes: (assumed) sent to the email from FR-1 on the same trigger as the SMS. Dependency: template owned by Design (Sanjay Mehta), currently half done (A [02:13]). [not stated] email content.

As an applicant, I want to see a progress bar, so that I know how far through the application I am. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I am partway through the application, when I view the application, then a progress bar shows how far through I am.. Notes: [not stated] which steps the bar covers. Confirmation unclear (G-6).

As an applicant, I want to save my progress and resume later, so that I can come back without starting again. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I have saved my progress, when I return within 14 days and log in with a mobile OTP, then I can resume my application.. Notes: [not stated] what happens after 14 days or to the saved data (U-1); whether FR-2 OTP rules apply to this login; whether saving is automatic or manual.

Summary: Complete the journey in about five minutes
Description: As an applicant, I want to open an account in about five minutes, so that I do not need a branch visit. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given I start an application on my phone, when I complete the journey, then my account is funded and usable within about five minutes of starting.. Notes: Conflicts with S-08 for non-domestic applicants (see C-1). Target is approximate ('like five minutes'); [not stated] whether maximum, average or percentile. 'Funded and usable' is undefined and funding method is TBD (U-2, G-5).

As a Compliance officer, I want every KYC decision logged, so that decisions can be audited. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given a KYC decision of pass, fail or refer is made, when it is made, then an audit log entry is created.; AC2: Given an audit log entry exists, when 7 years have not yet passed, then the entry is retained.. Notes: Owner: Data Platform, Lena Ortiz (C s5). [not stated] fields captured; whether a manual Compliance review outcome counts as a KYC decision (S-08).

As an applicant, I want the service to be available, so that I can open an account when I choose. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Given a calendar month, when availability is measured, then it is at least 99.9%.. Notes: [not stated] what is measured (whole service or components such as Veridian), downtime definition, maintenance exclusions.
